command: import copy,json,work; p=json.load(open('policy.json')); rs=json.load(open('requests.json')); expected=[work.evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]; actual=json.load(open('report.json')); assert actual==expected; rb=copy.deepcopy(rs); pb=copy.deepcopy(p); [work.evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]; assert rs==rb and p==pb; print('final checks passed')
